preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 100 for x in [int(n0), int(n1), int(n2)])
preconditions.description: Each of n0, n1, n2 is an integer between 0 and 100 inclusive, inclusive.
At least one of n0, n1, n2 is greater than 0.
The first line is t (number of test cases), followed by exactly t lines of n0, n1, n2.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.
Each output line is a non-empty binary string.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in line) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each output line consists only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == 1 + sum(int(n) for n in [n0, n1, n2]) for line, (n0, n1, n2) in zip(stdout.splitlines()[1:], [tuple(map(int, l.split())) for l in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the output string is 1 + (n0 + n1 + n2), where n0, n1, n2 are the input counts.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda s: (sum(1 for i in range(len(s)-1) if s[i] == '0' and s[i+1] == '0'), sum(1 for i in range(len(s)-1) if (s[i] == '0' and s[i+1] == '1') or (s[i] == '1' and s[i+1] == '0')), sum(1 for i in range(len(s)-1) if s[i] == '1' and s[i+1] == '1'))) == tuple(map(int, l.split())) for s, l in zip(stdout.splitlines()[1:], stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string s satisfies: n0 = number of '00' substrings, n1 = number of '01' or '10' substrings, n2 = number of '11' substrings.
